blocks.heading: Toynbee Hall works alongside people facing poverty and injustice to build a fairer and happier East London.
paragraphs: Based in the East End of London since 1884, we are a charity that provides vital support and works in partnership with local communities to tackle unfairness and ensure everyone has an equal chance to thrive.
Find out more about our work and what we do.

blocks.heading: A place for social change
blocks.body: From opening its doors in Whitechapel in 1884 to providing free legal advice, discover the people and ideas that shaped Toynbee Hall.

image.alt: Archive photograph of Toynbee Hall’s ivy-covered Victorian buildings, with tall chimneys and gables, around the courtyard.

items.title: Pro Bono Week 2026: Celebrating a legacy of access to justice
items.summary: As Pro Bono Week marks its 25th anniversary, Toynbee Hall reflects on the history of free legal advice and its own commitment to making justice accessible to everyone.

image.alt: Victorian engraving of Toynbee Hall, with people walking in the street outside.

items.title: Worried about money this Christmas?
items.summary: As London’s Christmas lights begin to go on, many people are already worrying about how they’ll afford the weeks ahead. For some of the people supported by Toynbee Hall, making ends meet means juggling two or three jobs alongside caring responsibilities, and still struggling to cover the bills.

image.alt: Two men smiling in front of BBC Broadcasting House, with the BBC Radio London and Toynbee Hall logos and the words Talk Money Week.

items.title: What this Budget must deliver for a stronger social safety net
items.byline: By Katie Taylor, Director of Policy, Research & Communities
items.summary: As the Chancellor prepares to deliver the Budget, this is an opportunity to set out what it must deliver to build a fairer and more effective social safety net, drawing on the experiences and expertise of the people we work alongside at Toynbee Hall.

image.alt: Council housing blocks contrasted with modern high-rise flats in the background in East London

items.title: Toynbee Hall shortlisted for national technology award for Video Advice Kiosks
items.summary: Toynbee Hall has been shortlisted for Best Use of Technology at the UKCCF Awards 2026. The nomination recognises the development and deployment of our Video Advice Kiosks, which connect people directly with qualified advisers in locations where conventional advice can be difficult to access.

image.alt: UKCCF Awards 2026 ‘Shortlisted’ graphic with a glass award trophy.

blocks.heading: Hire our
paragraphs: Our Grade II listed building in East London is now available to hire for a range of private and corporate events including conferences, seminars, receptions or training sessions, weddings and celebrations. Our historic building has been a hub for social action since 1884 and could be the perfect venue for your event.

Depending on the size and scope of your event, we offer five halls for hire. We can also provide additional services such as event production and catering, so you can rest assured we’ll take care of everything. Book our halls for your next event.
